items.title: "The Gentlemen" ransomware group hits Canadian airline
items.summary: The Gentlemen ransomware group claimed an attack on a Canadian airline during the second week of September 2026.

items.title: Black X ransomware strikes South Korean auto parts manufacturer
items.summary: Black X ransomware attacked a South Korean automotive parts manufacturer during the first week of September 2026.

items.title: ZaWoo extortion campaign hits multiple global organizations
items.summary: The ZaWoo data-extortion group conducted attacks against multiple organizations worldwide in early September 2026.

items.title: AUDIT TEAM extortion group claims four victims across three countries
items.summary: AUDIT TEAM conducted data-extortion attacks on four organizations in South Korea, Germany, and Argentina during the second week of September 2026.

items.title: Azure East US outage takes down ChatGPT, Claude, and Grok
items.summary: A roughly 90-minute Azure East US outage on September 3, 2026 disrupted ChatGPT, Claude, and Grok simultaneously, underscoring concentration risk across shared cloud regions.

outage.note: Limited fresh cloud-outage reporting this cycle beyond the Azure East US incident; hyperscaler analysts continue to flag elevated multi-day outage risk through the rest of 2026.

items.title: SonicWall SMA 1000 SSRF flaw (CVSS 10.0) added to CISA KEV
items.summary: CVE-2026-83548, a maximum-severity server-side request forgery vulnerability in SonicWall SMA 1000 appliances, was added to the CISA KEV catalog after confirmed active exploitation.

items.title: Sangoma Switchvox SQL injection flaw exploited in the wild
items.summary: CVE-2026-9586, a SQL injection vulnerability in Sangoma Switchvox, was added to CISA's Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog.

items.title: Starlette HTTP request-smuggling bug added to KEV
items.summary: CVE-2026-48710, an HTTP request/response smuggling vulnerability in the Kludex Starlette framework, was added to the CISA KEV catalog, with downstream exposure for apps built on it.

items.title: Attackers deploy reverse shells and crypto miners via newly KEV-listed flaw
items.summary: CISA added CVE-2026-49869 to its KEV catalog after observing attackers using it to deploy reverse shells and cryptocurrency miners.

items.title: Chromium V8 type-confusion zero-day added to KEV
items.summary: CVE-2026-85046, a type confusion vulnerability in Google Chromium's V8 engine, was added to the CISA KEV catalog, posing significant risk to federal enterprise browsers.

items.title: Cisco ISE privileged-API flaw added to KEV
items.summary: CVE-2026-76460, an incorrect-use-of-privileged-APIs vulnerability in Cisco Identity Services Engine, was added to the CISA KEV catalog on September 16, 2026.

items.title: Acronis Backup default-permissions flaw added to KEV
items.summary: CVE-2026-87886, an incorrect default permissions vulnerability in Acronis Backup, was added to the CISA KEV catalog on September 16, 2026.

items.title: M 6.5 earthquake strikes west of Nikolski, Alaska
items.summary: A magnitude 6.5 earthquake struck 165 km west of Nikolski, Alaska on September 17, 2026, with a tsunami advisory issued (green alert).

items.title: M 6.5 earthquake strikes near Teluknaga, Indonesia
items.summary: A magnitude 6.5 earthquake struck 126 km NNE of Teluknaga, Indonesia on September 11, 2026 (green alert, no tsunami warning).

physical.note: Search for named hurricane, wildfire, and flood events returned limited September-dated results with verifiable sourcing this cycle; seismic activity is the primary confirmed physical/natural BC signal today.
